name: weeklane
description: Plan your week in Weeklane: read your week, add, move, complete and delete tasks, manage repeating tasks, reminders and Task Lock, and undo changes.

interface.longDescription:
Weeklane is a simple weekly planner for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android: one list of tasks per day, with times, reminders and repeating tasks. With the Weeklane app in ChatGPT you can plan your week in conversation and see the result on your phone within seconds.

What you can ask:
- "What's on my list this week?" ChatGPT reads your week or a single day and can search your tasks by name.
- "Plan my week: gym Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 7, and the dentist on Thursday at 10." ChatGPT adds all the tasks in one step, with times and phone reminders if you want them, including reminders the evening before.
- "Move everything I didn't finish today to tomorrow." Edit, move, check off or delete tasks one at a time or in bulk. ChatGPT asks before deleting anything or changing many tasks at once.
- "Skip gym this Friday." Set up, change, skip or stop repeating tasks.
- "Turn on Task Lock from 9:00 with my Social list." On iPhone and iPad, see whether Task Lock is on, turn it on or off, set when it starts, allow breaks and switch between block lists you saved on your phone. ChatGPT never sees or chooses which apps are blocked.
- "Undo that." The last change can be reverted in one step, here or in the Weeklane app.

How it works: connect Weeklane, sign in with the same Apple or Google account you use in the Weeklane app, and approve access on the Weeklane consent screen. Every change is labelled with the assistant's name in the app, listed under Settings → Plan with AI, and can be revoked there at any time. Weeklane only accesses your personal tasks, never shared projects, and does not sell your data or use it to train AI.

Requirements: the Weeklane app version 3.0 or later, signed in with Apple or Google.
capabilities: Show the user's Weeklane week or one day, grouped by day
Search tasks by words in the title
Add up to 50 tasks at once with optional times and phone reminders
Edit, move, complete and delete tasks, one at a time or in bulk
Create, change, skip or stop repeating tasks
Read and change Task Lock settings on iPhone and iPad (on/off, start time, breaks, saved block list)
Undo the assistant's last change in one step
